## MCP - Documents Validate (RFC-014)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/documents/validate

**Input:**
- `file_url` or `file_base64`: Document
- `action`: translate | summarize | custom
- `params`: Action parameters
- `plugin_context`: { available_actions, required_params, custom_actions }

**Output:**
- `valid`: boolean
- `can_proceed`: boolean
- `missing`: array of missing params
- `questions`: array of questions to ask user
